title: Seeker soldier trophy
content:
# Seeker soldier trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophySeekerBrute | Source: Seeker Soldier | Usage: Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Seeker soldier trophies are a rare drop(5%) from Seeker Soldiers.
Three of these can be used on the altar at the top of an Infested Citadel to re-summon The Queen after she has been defeated.

## Notes

• Can be displayed in an item stand.
• Can be used to program Balistas.

Categorias: Trophies, Forsaken offerings
